quests.instruction: Which solid shape is like a circle with a curved surface rising up to meet a single point above it?
quests.question: Cone
quests.hint: Think of the solid version of a circle that has been pulled up into a peak.
quests.explanation: A cone is like a flat circle with a curved surface that rises up to a single point.
quests.funFact: This is why a cone can be described as the solid version of a flat circle, pulled to a peak.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape is like a flat polygon base with triangle sides folded up to meet at a single point?
quests.question: Pyramid
quests.hint: Think of the solid version of a flat shape, folded upward into a peak instead of a curve.
quests.explanation: A pyramid is like a flat polygon with triangle sides folded upward to meet at a single point.
quests.funFact: Unlike a cone's curved surface, a pyramid's sides are always flat triangles.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape is like a circle stretched straight upward, keeping the same round shape the whole way?
quests.question: Cylinder
quests.hint: Think of the solid version of a circle, pushed straight up instead of coming to a point.
quests.explanation: A cylinder is like a circle stretched straight upward, keeping the same round shape all the way up.
quests.funFact: Unlike a cone, a cylinder keeps the exact same circle size from bottom to top.

quests.instruction: Which flat 2D shape is the closest match to one face of a cube?
quests.question: Square
quests.hint: Think about what shape you'd draw if you traced around just one side of a die.
quests.explanation: Tracing around one face of a cube always gives you a square.
quests.funFact: A cube is basically made of 6 identical squares joined together.

quests.instruction: Which flat 2D shape is the closest match to one face of a rectangular prism?
quests.question: Rectangle
quests.hint: Think about what shape you'd draw if you traced around the side of a shoebox.
quests.explanation: Tracing around a face of a rectangular prism usually gives you a rectangle.
quests.funFact: A rectangular prism's faces can sometimes be squares too, but rectangle is the general match.

quests.instruction: Which flat 2D shape is the closest match to one flat end of a cylinder?
quests.question: Circle
quests.hint: Think about what shape you'd draw if you traced around the lid of a can.
quests.explanation: Tracing around a flat end of a cylinder always gives you a circle.
quests.funFact: A can's flat lid is a great everyday example of a perfect circle.

quests.instruction: Which flat 2D shape is the closest match to one slanted face of a pyramid?
quests.question: Triangle
quests.hint: Think about what shape you'd draw if you traced around one slanted side of a pyramid.
quests.explanation: Tracing around a slanted face of a pyramid usually gives you a triangle.
quests.funFact: All those triangle faces meet together at the pyramid's single top point.

quests.instruction: Which flat 2D shape is the closest match to the base of a cone?
quests.question: Circle
quests.hint: Think about what shape you'd draw if you traced around the bottom rim of an ice cream cone.
quests.explanation: Tracing around the base of a cone always gives you a circle.
quests.funFact: A cone's only flat face is always a perfect circle.

quests.instruction: Which flat 2D shape would you get by tracing one face of a sugar cube?
quests.question: Square
quests.hint: Think about the flat shape on any side of a tiny sugar cube.
quests.explanation: Tracing one face of a sugar cube always gives you a square, since all cube faces are squares.
quests.funFact: No matter how small a cube is, its faces are still perfect squares.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape would a flat circle turn into if you spun it around and gave it depth in every direction?
quests.question: Sphere
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape you'd get by puffing up a flat circle equally on all sides.
quests.explanation: Giving a flat circle equal depth in every direction turns it into a sphere.
quests.funFact: This is a fun way to picture how 2D shapes relate to their 3D solid cousins.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape would a flat square turn into if you gave it equal depth straight back?
quests.question: Cube
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape you'd get by pushing a flat square straight back with equal depth.
quests.explanation: Giving a flat square equal depth in every direction turns it into a cube.
quests.funFact: This trick works because a cube's faces are exactly the same shape as the square you started with.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape would a flat circle turn into if you pushed it straight back with even depth, not into a point?
quests.question: Cylinder
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape you'd get by stacking many identical circles directly on top of each other.
quests.explanation: Stacking identical circles straight up, without narrowing to a point, creates a cylinder.
quests.funFact: This is different from a cone, which narrows to a point instead of staying the same width.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape would a flat rectangle turn into if you gave it depth that isn't equal to its sides?
quests.question: Rectangular Prism
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape you'd get by pushing a flat rectangle straight back.
quests.explanation: Giving a flat rectangle depth (that doesn't match its other sides) turns it into a rectangular prism.
quests.funFact: If that depth happened to match the other sides exactly, you'd end up with a cube instead.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape would a flat triangle help build if 3 or more of them were joined at a single top point above a base?
quests.question: Pyramid
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape made from triangle sides all meeting at one peak.
quests.explanation: Joining triangle faces at a single top point above a flat base builds a pyramid.
quests.funFact: Depending on the base shape, a pyramid can have 3, 4, 5, or more triangle sides.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape would a flat circle help build if its edge were connected upward to a single point?
quests.question: Cone
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape made from a circle base and a curved surface rising to a peak.
quests.explanation: Connecting a circle's edge up to a single point above it builds a cone.
quests.funFact: Unlike a pyramid, a cone's rising surface is smoothly curved instead of made of flat triangles.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape is a special rectangular prism where every face happens to be an equal square?
quests.question: Cube
quests.hint: Think of the box shape that is extra balanced, with no face longer than another.
quests.explanation: A cube is a special rectangular prism where every one of its 6 faces is an equal square.
quests.funFact: That means every cube is a rectangular prism, but not every rectangular prism is a cube.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape rolls equally well no matter which part of its surface touches the ground?
quests.question: Sphere
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape with a surface that is identical at every single point.
quests.explanation: A sphere rolls equally well from any point on its surface, since every point is exactly the same distance from the center.
quests.funFact: This is why balls used in sports are always shaped like spheres.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape rolls smoothly along its curved side but not along its flat circle ends?
quests.question: Cylinder
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape that behaves like a wheel on its side, but not on its ends.
quests.explanation: A cylinder rolls smoothly on its curved side, but its flat circle ends keep it from rolling that way.
quests.funFact: This is why cans roll easily on their side but stand still upright.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape has flat triangle faces that lean inward as they rise, unlike a cylinder's straight sides?
quests.question: Pyramid
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape that narrows steadily from a wide base to a single point.
quests.explanation: A pyramid's triangle faces lean inward as they rise, narrowing all the way to a single point.
quests.funFact: A cylinder's sides, by contrast, go straight up without narrowing at all.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape narrows evenly from a round base to a point, with one smooth curved surface, no flat sides?
quests.question: Cone
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape whose only flat part is its base, unlike a pyramid's flat triangle sides.
quests.explanation: A cone narrows evenly from a round base to a point with one smooth curved surface, unlike a pyramid's flat sides.
quests.funFact: This smooth curve is the biggest difference between a cone and a pyramid.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape has faces that are always flat rectangles (or squares), never curved or triangular?
quests.question: Rectangular Prism
quests.hint: Think of the box-shaped solid whose faces are always flat and four-sided.
quests.explanation: A rectangular prism's faces are always flat, four-sided shapes — rectangles or squares, never curved or triangular.
quests.funFact: This flat, four-sided pattern is what makes boxes so easy to stack and store.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape has a surface that curves the same way in absolutely every direction?
quests.question: Sphere
quests.hint: Think of the roundest solid shape, curving identically no matter which way you check.
quests.explanation: A sphere's surface curves the exact same way in every single direction, unlike a cylinder or cone.
quests.funFact: A cylinder curves around its side but is flat on top and bottom — very different from a sphere.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape has every angle between its faces forming a perfect right angle, just like a square's corners?
quests.question: Cube
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape whose flat faces always meet at perfect square corners.
quests.explanation: Every angle between a cube's faces forms a perfect right angle, just like the corners of a square.
quests.funFact: This is part of why cubes fit so neatly into square shelves and boxes.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape has angles between its triangle faces that lean inward, unlike a cube's straight-up corners?
quests.question: Pyramid
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape whose faces slant inward instead of standing straight up.
quests.explanation: A pyramid's triangle faces lean inward toward the top point, unlike a cube's straight-up-and-down faces.
quests.funFact: This inward lean is exactly what gives a pyramid its pointed, triangular silhouette.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape has flat circle faces on each end that are always perfectly parallel to each other?
quests.question: Cylinder
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape whose top and bottom faces always face the exact same direction.
quests.explanation: A cylinder's two flat circle faces are always perfectly parallel to each other.
quests.funFact: This parallel design is why a stack of cylinder-shaped cans balances so evenly.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape has 3 different possible face shapes appearing in pairs — top/bottom, front/back, and left/right?
quests.question: Rectangular Prism
quests.hint: Think of the box shape where opposite faces always match each other.
quests.explanation: A rectangular prism has 3 pairs of matching faces: top/bottom, front/back, and left/right.
quests.funFact: In a cube, all three of those pairs happen to be the exact same size and shape.

quests.instruction: Which solid shape has exactly 1 curved surface and 1 flat face, connected at a single circular edge?
quests.question: Cone
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape with only one flat part, joined to a curve at one circular edge.
quests.explanation: A cone has 1 curved surface and 1 flat circle face, meeting at a single circular edge.
quests.funFact: That circular edge is exactly where the flat base meets the curved surface of the cone.

quests.instruction: Out of every solid shape you've learned, which one has the simplest possible surface — just one smooth curve?
quests.question: Sphere
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape with zero flat faces, zero edges, and zero corners.
quests.explanation: A sphere has the simplest surface of all: one smooth curve, with zero faces, edges, or corners.
quests.funFact: Every other solid shape you've learned has at least one flat face or one sharp corner.

quests.instruction: Out of every solid shape you've learned, which one has the most balanced set of faces, edges, and corners?
quests.question: Cube
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape where every face, edge, and corner matches perfectly.
quests.explanation: A cube's 6 equal square faces, 12 equal edges, and 8 matching corners make it the most balanced shape here.
quests.funFact: This perfect balance is exactly why cubes are used for dice, blocks, and puzzles.

quests.instruction: Out of every solid shape you've learned, which one is the only one built entirely from flat triangle sides meeting at a point?
quests.question: Pyramid
quests.hint: Think of the solid shape whose sloped faces are always flat triangles, never curved.
quests.explanation: A pyramid is the only shape here built entirely from flat triangle sides, all meeting at one point.
quests.funFact: A cone looks similar, but its sloped surface is smoothly curved instead of made of flat triangles.
